name: Stack Overflow questions
question: Do developers still ask other people?
metric: Questions asked on Stack Overflow, latest full month
solvedIf: Developers stop asking people for help with code
trendLabel: Questions asked on Stack Overflow per month.
caution: Questions were already falling before ChatGPT, and the site's own rules and popularity also play a part, so AI is only one possible cause.
Developers may be asking AI, or asking elsewhere. Fewer questions does not mean fewer people are needed to build software. Deleted questions are not counted, which can change older months.
rule: Asking less when fewer questions are asked than in the same month a year before.
scoreReason: Down 99% since ChatGPT launched. Falling to a tenth scores 100%.
